#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    long long a, b, c, d, e;
    Point(long long a, long long b, long long c, long long d, long long e) : a(a), b(b), c(c), d(d), e(e) {}
    bool dot(const Point& rhs) const {
        return a * rhs.a + b * rhs.b + c * rhs.c + d * rhs.d + e * rhs.e > 0;
    }
    Point minus(const Point& rhs) const {
        return Point(a - rhs.a, b - rhs.b, c - rhs.c, d - rhs.d, e - rhs.e);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 40) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    } else {
        vector<Point> points;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            long long a, b, c, d, e;
            cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
            points.emplace_back(a, b, c, d, e);
        }
        if (n < 3) {
            cout << n << endl;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                cout << i << endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        vector<int> result;
        for (int center = 0; center < n; ++center) {
            bool find = false;
            for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
                if (a != center) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                        if (b != center && b != a) {
                            Point A = points[a].minus(points[center]);
                            Point B = points[b].minus(points[center]);
                            if (A.dot(B)) {
                                find = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (find) break;
                }
            }
            if (!find) result.push_back(center + 1);
        }
        cout << result.size() << endl;
        for (int id : result) {
            cout << id << endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
